Twelve themes, on the real Canvas

Each theme is a paper pair, an accent, a wash over the course colour band, and a faint texture drawn on the laptop. Left: the dashboard with the Today block, light. Right: Modules, dark. Every ink pair is measured; body text never drops under 7:1 and links never under 4.5:1.

Classic Cream the default, calm

Dark Academia parchment, oxblood, old library

Blush soft pink, bows, matcha lattes

Lavender Haze lilac, late night, headphones on

Matcha sage, clay, quiet morning

Coastal sea glass, linen, open window

Midnight navy, electric blue, 2am

Sunset peach to coral, golden hour

Cherry Blossom petals, spring, pink on navy at night

Lo-fi muted purple, rain on the window

Cottage cream, moss, terracotta

Night Shift the blue-grey dark, for the late shift
